name: Arabica coffee
summary: Vietnam Tourism’s discover article suggests a hot coffee at sunrise while Mang Den sits in cloud. The coolcation article names locally grown Arabica, sipped while the mist lifts. The two lines are not called one recipe. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den. The rural portal also lists cà phê among farm goods at the weekend market. That line is the crop for sale.
howToEat: The discover article says a cup of hot coffee with the sunrise.
The coolcation article says locally grown Arabica while the mist lifts. It does not say that cup is iced or hot.
A price is Check on arrival. A cafe street was not named. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: No cafe street is named on either Vietnam Tourism article.

The weekend market lists cà phê with mắc ca and gạo đỏ, as farm goods. Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Coffee in Mang Den — hot sunrise cup, local Arabica
seoDescription: A hot coffee at sunrise on the Vietnam Tourism discover article. The coolcation article names locally grown Arabica. A price is Check on arrival.
